description: ORGANIZER-ONLY. Do not share with participants before code freeze. Hidden evaluation set run after the battle ends.

questions.question: How many business days does an employee have to return company equipment after their last day?
questions.gold_answer: 10 business days.

questions.question: What is the remediation target for a Critical severity vulnerability?
questions.gold_answer: 7 days.

questions.question: What is the annual learning and development budget per employee?
questions.gold_answer: $1,500 per year.

questions.question: What is the minimum required password length at Acme Cloud?
questions.gold_answer: 12 characters.

questions.question: How many consecutive failed login attempts trigger an account lockout?
questions.gold_answer: 10 consecutive failed attempts, resulting in a 15-minute lockout.

questions.question: What is the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) for a full regional failover?
questions.gold_answer: 30 minutes.

questions.question: How often do database credentials in the secrets vault rotate automatically?
questions.gold_answer: Every 90 days.

questions.question: How long does the free trial last for new customers?
questions.gold_answer: 14 days.

questions.question: Can an engineer outside the Platform team deploy to production during a P1 incident?
questions.gold_answer: Yes, but only via emergency approval granted by the Incident Commander; the standard policy restricts approval to Platform team members, and the emergency approval must be reviewed retroactively by Platform within 24 hours.

questions.question: How does a new engineer get access to read production secrets?
questions.gold_answer: Not automatically during onboarding — they must submit a request via access-control.md's process (manager approval plus a security team lead's sign-off) to join the secrets-readers group.

questions.question: How much longer are security audit logs kept compared to general application logs?
questions.gold_answer: Security audit logs are retained for 1 year, versus 30 days hot / 90 days total for general application logs — audit logs are kept several months longer.

questions.question: How many days do customers currently have to request a refund, and how does that compare to the old policy?
questions.gold_answer: Customers currently have 30 days (effective July 2025), up from the previous, now-deprecated 14-day window.

questions.question: Who becomes the Incident Commander, and what special authority does that role have during a P1?
questions.gold_answer: The on-call engineer who first acknowledges the page becomes the Incident Commander by default; the IC can grant emergency deployment approval to any engineer during a P1, regardless of team.

questions.question: If planned maintenance causes downtime, is that downtime counted against the uptime SLA?
questions.gold_answer: No, as long as customers were notified at least 72 hours in advance, per the change management process; such planned maintenance is excluded from the uptime calculation.

questions.question: Who's allowed to sign off on pushing code live to production?
questions.gold_answer: Only members of the Platform team (with the P1 incident emergency exception).

questions.question: If I get locked out after too many wrong password attempts, how long until I can try again?
questions.gold_answer: 15 minutes.

questions.question: What's the yearly cash amount Acme gives remote employees to set up their home workspace?
questions.gold_answer: $500 per year.

questions.question: How quickly does Acme need to react if a critical vulnerability is actively being exploited?
questions.gold_answer: It's treated as a P1 security incident, so the P1 targets apply: 15-minute acknowledgment and 4-hour resolution, overriding the normal 7-day critical remediation window.

questions.question: What programming language does the Finance team use?
questions.gold_answer: The documentation does not specify this.

questions.question: Is there a maximum number of pets allowed in an Acme Cloud office?
questions.gold_answer: The documentation does not specify this.

questions.question: Does Acme Cloud offer a native mobile app for the customer dashboard?
questions.gold_answer: The documentation does not specify this.

questions.question: What color scheme is used on Acme Cloud's public marketing website?
questions.gold_answer: The documentation does not specify this.

questions.question: Which teams are NOT allowed to approve production deployments?
questions.gold_answer: All teams other than Platform (e.g. Ingest, Query, Alerting, Billing) — approval is restricted to Platform team members except during a P1 emergency-approval exception.

questions.question: How many days do customers have to request a refund? (Careful — one document is outdated.)
questions.gold_answer: 30 days. The 14-day figure in refunds.md is explicitly marked deprecated as of June 2025 and superseded by deprecation-policy.md.

questions.question: What is Acme Cloud's response time commitment for a Sev1 incident?
questions.gold_answer: Sev1 is the same as P1 at Acme Cloud, so the P1 targets apply: 15-minute acknowledgment, 4-hour resolution.

questions.question: Does the Infrastructure team approve production deployments?
questions.gold_answer: There is no separate "Infrastructure team" at Acme Cloud — the Platform team owns shared infrastructure and is the only team authorized to approve production deployments.
